scope: Seven selected guarded updater/commit/final-HEAD-lock paths, caller shells/hooks, shared cache and local Git race

steps.name: Configure Git
steps.script:
git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

steps.name: Record starting revision
steps.script:
echo "UPDATE_START_REF=$(git rev-parse HEAD)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
cp flake.lock "$RUNNER_TEMP/flake-update-baseline.lock"
echo "UPDATE_OLD_LOCK=$RUNNER_TEMP/flake-update-baseline.lock" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Update flake input
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail

old_rev="$(nix shell "$CONFCTL_FLAKE" -c confctl inputs ls --json nixpkgs | jq -er '
  map(select(.input == "nixpkgs"))
  | if length == 1 then .[0].rev | select(type == "string" and length > 0) else empty end
')"
if [ -z "$old_rev" ]; then
  echo "Unable to read nixpkgs revision from flake.lock." >&2
  exit 1
fi

nix shell "$CONFCTL_FLAKE" -c confctl inputs update --forward-only nixpkgs

if git diff --quiet -- flake.lock; then
  echo "No flake input updates to commit."
  exit 0
fi

new_rev="$(nix shell "$CONFCTL_FLAKE" -c confctl inputs ls --json nixpkgs | jq -er '
  map(select(.input == "nixpkgs"))
  | if length == 1 then .[0].rev | select(type == "string" and length > 0) else empty end
')"
if [ -z "$new_rev" ]; then
  echo "Unable to read updated nixpkgs revision from flake.lock." >&2
  exit 1
fi

commit_msg="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$commit_msg"' EXIT

printf 'flake: nixpkgs %.11s -> %.11s\n' "$old_rev" "$new_rev" > "$commit_msg"

git add -- flake.lock
git commit -F "$commit_msg"

steps.name: Check committed dependency updates
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail

if ! git diff --quiet || ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
  git status --short
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Push changes
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail

if [ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$UPDATE_START_REF" ]; then
  echo "No dependency updates to push."
  exit 0
fi

final_lock="$RUNNER_TEMP/flake-update-final.lock"
git show HEAD:flake.lock > "$final_lock"
nix shell "$CONFCTL_FLAKE" -c confctl inputs check-update \
  --old-lock "$UPDATE_OLD_LOCK" --new-lock "$final_lock"
